files.description: New cumulative V1 integration test (sections A-D: runtime lifecycle, periodic topology, termination reporting, combined API/import). CPU forced; tiny instance constructed, never stepped.
Task 1 regression re-run (CG3D-TAICHI-INIT-001): import of lbm_solver_cg3d has no Taichi side effect; cg3d.runtime.init_runtime() is the boundary.
Task 1 regression re-run on the cumulative base: Level A structural sanity A1-A5 on one 32^3 solver instance (CPU).
Host-side post-processing/logic checks (21 checks incl. label_periodic and eval_convergence), re-run on the cumulative base.
Task 2 regression re-run (CG3D-PERIODIC-CONN-002): 6/18/26 topology on wrapped seams incl. brute-force torus oracle over 252 combinations.
Task 3 regression re-run (CG3D-CONVERGENCE-DIAG-003): termination / numerical_health reporting over the real run_hold with a fake system.
Checkpoint/resume regression re-run (PR-7) crossing runtime init, OpenSystem, drivers and persisted state (CPU, incl. 3 driver subprocesses).
Per-validation command, interpreter, exit code, elapsed seconds and PASS/FAIL status for the seven requested validations.
